Application Data.NAME: Creative Design Studio, LLC
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Creative Design Studio, LLC specializes in providing innovative graphic design services, including branding, digital illustration, and print design. Our team of skilled professionals focuses on maintaining organized digital workflows and utilizes industry-standard design software to ensure compliance and reduce error risks. We operate from a dedicated office space in Springfield, IL, where we uphold strict security protocols and data protection measures. Our practices include secure data backup and a commitment to delivering high-quality products while following safety regulations in our design processes. We prioritize client collaboration and satisfaction through effective communication and personalized design solutions.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2022, a computer malfunction resulted in the loss of a project's digital files, requiring restoration efforts. The total cost of recovery was $1,500. Status: Resolved and measures implemented to enhance data backup protocols. On June 10, 2023, minor water damage due to a leaky roof caused $1,000 in damages, which has since been repaired. Status: Closed after restoration.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Medeco M3 High Security Safe - Class 1, UL Listed
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security cameras and alarm system in place; office access is restricted to authorized personnel only.
